next.reason: 1985 GR4 'The REPORT clause is presented on page XIII-9' only points to where the report FD's REPORT clause is specified; it sets no program requirement. 2023 keeps the REPORT clause in the report FD, §2023:13.4.5.2 'Format 3 (report)' ending in REPORT IS / REPORTS ARE report-name-1, and presents it in its own subclause, §2023:13.18.46.2 'REPORTS ARE'. The same programs are accepted with the same meaning. GR-13.18.46.4-1 and SR-13.4.5.3-8 state other requirements (multiple reports per file, Format 3's identity) and are not part of this pointer.
